title: docs/KERNEL_COMPAT.md: kernel version compatibility notes
description: Document the kernel version compatibility matrix for wolfkm: which versions are tested, which wolfkm_compat.h shims cover which version differences, any known issues per distro/version, and the process for adding support for new kernel versions. Covers 5.10 through 6.x. Cross-references wolfkm_compat.h sections.
design: Sections: Supported Versions table (version, distro, kernel-version, status), API Changes Handled (what changed, which kernel version, which compat shim), Known Issues (per-version quirks), Adding a New Kernel Version (procedure). Built from the notes accumulated while writing wolfkm_compat.h.
acceptance_criteria: Document accurately describes every shim in wolfkm_compat.h with the kernel version it covers. A developer can follow the 'Adding a New Kernel Version' procedure without ambiguity.
close_reason: Created accurate docs based on actual codebase state
